summary:
ReliQ is an interactive, story-driven educational platform designed for students aged 14–18. It transforms space exploration into an immersive learning journey where students hear the rover tell its own story and discover its mission, features, and scientific achievements.
Students explore an interactive 3D model of the rover, learn about three of its engineering components through hands-on educational activities, and then embark on a simulated space mission. During this final mission, students test their understanding by making decisions related to a real mission carried out by that rover.
By combining storytelling, 3D exploration, engineering concepts, and real NASA mission data, ReliQ bridges the gap between scientific knowledge and practical learning. It aims to inspire curiosity, develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills, and introduce students to the world of space exploration and engineering.
